## Step 7 — record the chart and the exact watchlist
Follow the setup procedure in this packet's `SKILL.md`. Resolve the user's watchlist with
`watchlist_list` and `watchlist_get_by_id`, and the chart with `layout_list` and
`layout_get_active`. Record the selected watchlist id, name, ordered symbols and count,
layout id and name, timeframe, account currency/size and slot count in the conversation's
workspace. Read that record back and state the choices to the user. If names are ambiguous,
ask which id they want; never silently pick another list with the same name.
The collector shipped here is `report/collect.mjs`. It has no settings or layout-saving
command. The record preserves the user's choices for the next run; it does not configure
TradingView automatically. Before each scan, follow `SKILL.md` to apply the recorded layout
by id and verify `layout_get_active` returns that exact id with TC-TIDE present and readable.
